blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Real-world text-to-SQL systems often face schema ambiguity, where a question can map to multiple plausible schema elements. To support downstream disambiguation, SQL generation systems should include diverse interpretations among their top-k predictions. However, large language models (LLMs) typically favor a single interpretation, producing highly skewed outputs. We propose Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment (SLA), a training-free decoding method that promotes diverse SQL generation by adjusting token logits based on semantic similarity between schema elements. Unlike prior approaches that rely on reasoning-intensive prompting or task-specific fine-tuning, SLA is efficient, model-agnostic, and easy to deploy. Experiments show that SLA consistently improves interpretation coverage over standard decoding and remains competitive with existing diversity-oriented methods at substantially lower inference cost.
blocks.zh: Real-world text-to-SQL系统经常面临计划模糊,其中一个问题可以映射到多种可能的计划元素. 为了支持下游的混淆,SQL生成系统应当在其顶端k的预测中包括不同的解释. 然而,大型语言模型通常倾向于单一解释,产生高度扭曲的产出。 我们提出语义感知逻辑调整(SLA),这是一种无训练解码方法,它通过根据语义学在计数元素之间的相似性来调整符号日志,促进多种SQL生成. 与以往依赖推理密集的提示或任务特定微调的方法不同,SLA是高效的,模式不可知的,易于部署. 实验表明,苏丹解放军在标准解码方面不断提高口译覆盖面,并且仍然与现有的以多样性为导向的方法有竞争力,其推论成本要低得多。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models have shown remarkable performance in many tasks. Among them, text-to-SQL plays an important role in transforming user natural language questions into executable SQL queries. Over recent years, many works have made significant progress on benchmarks such as SPIDER ( Yu et al. 2018 ) and BIRD ( Li et al. 2023 ) , indicating the potential of LLMs as an assistant for SQL writing.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型在许多任务中表现出显著的性能. 其中,文本到SQL在将用户自然语言问题转换为可执行的SQL查询方面发挥了重要作用. 近年来,许多作品在天基信息平台(Yu等人,2018年)和BIRD(Li等人,2023年)等基准方面取得了重大进展,表明LLMs作为SQL写作助理的潜力.

blocks.en: In practice, however, the questions people actually ask are rarely so well posed. A user question can be ambiguous, and several different but equally valid SQL queries could answer it ( Floratou et al. 2024 ) , whereas most existing benchmarks sidestep this by assuming that each question is clear and corresponds to a single ground truth. The source of ambiguity can roughly be classified into three types: database schema, database value and natural language. Among them, schema ambiguity ( Bhaskar et al. 2023 ; Wang et al. 2023 ; Floratou et al. 2024 ) refers to the scenario where an entity in the user question can refer to different database schema elements (tables or columns). It is a major source of failure in real-world applications ( Wang et al. 2023 ) , because the database can contain similar concepts, users are unfamiliar with the database, and natural language expressions often omit crucial expressions. For example in Fig. 1 , it is unclear whether the user wants the name or the ISBN of the books, and whether the books should be filtered by German writers or by German publishers. Since the system cannot resolve the ambiguity in such a question on the user’s behalf, the practical requirement is that every plausible reading survives: all valid interpretations should appear among the top- k k predictions, so that they can be presented to the user or passed to a disambiguation module. We refer to this property as interpretation coverage.
blocks.zh: 然而,在实践中,人们实际提出的问题很少提出这么好的问题。 一个用户问题可能模糊不清,几个不同但同样有效的SQL查询可以回答它(Floratou等人,2024年),而大多数现有基准都绕过这一点,假设每个问题都是清楚的,与一个单一的基础真理相对应. 模棱两可的来源大致可分为三类:数据库计划,数据库值和自然语言. 其中,计划含糊不清(Baskar等人)。 2023; 王等编. 2023 ; Floratou et al. 2024 )是指用户问题中一个实体可以指不同数据库的schema元素(表或列)的情景. 它是现实世界应用中失败的主要原因(Wang et al. 2023),因为数据库可以包含类似的概念,用户对数据库不熟悉,自然语言表达方式往往省略关键表达方式. 例如在图1中,不清楚用户是想要书名还是书本的ISBN,这些书是应该由德国作家还是由德国出版商过滤. 由于该系统不能代表用户解决这种问题的模糊性,所以实际要求是,每个可信的读数都必须存活下来:所有有效的解释都应该出现在最高级的- k k 预测中,以便可以提交给用户或传递到一个混淆不清的模块中。 我们将此财产称为解释范围。

blocks.en: Figure 1: An illustration example of our framework. Given a user question over a database, we first precompute the prefix tree and pairwise semantic similarities of all schema elements, and then adjust the output distribution based on the pointer and similarity. As a result, our method facilitates the model to explore more potential schema interpretations.
blocks.zh: 图 1:我们框架的一个实例。 鉴于一个数据库上的用户问题,我们首先会预先计算所有schema元素的前缀树和对偶语义的相似性,然后根据指针和相似性调整输出分布. 因此,我们的方法有助于模型探索更多的潜在计划解释。

blocks.en: The most natural way to obtain such a set is diverse decoding, such as beam search and random sampling, which is efficient and requires no additional training. Previous work has shown, however, that these methods are ineffective at generating semantically different SQL queries, mainly due to highly skewed logit distributions ( Bhaskar et al. 2023 ) : at the very step where the interpretations diverge, a single token dominates the distribution and the alternative is buried far below. Existing works resort to alternative paradigms, like reasoning-intensive prompting ( Ding, Lin, and Zeng 2025 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ) or task-specific fine-tuning ( Saparina and Lapata 2025a ; Saparina and Lapata 2025b ) . While effective, they have two main limitations: (1) they introduce high computational cost due to test-time scaling or the training procedure; (2) they have weak applicability to a broader range of base models, as they assume reasoning-capable or task-adapted LLMs. We therefore ask whether the skewed distribution can instead be repaired during decoding, which would retain the efficiency, the training-free nature and the broad applicability that made diverse decoding attractive in the first place: can we facilitate interpretation coverage by improving the decoding itself?
blocks.zh: 获得这种集的最自然的方法是多样的解码,如梁式搜索和随机采样,这是有效的,不需要额外的训练. 然而,先前的研究表明,这些方法无法产生明显不同的SQL查询,这主要是因为对数分布高度扭曲(Bhaskar等人,2023年):在解释不一的阶段,一种符号支配着分配,替代符号埋藏在很深的下面。 现有作品采用另类范式,如推理密集促动(丁、林和曾2025;张等人2025)或任务特定微调(Saparina和Lapata 2025a;Saparina和Lapata 2025b)。 它们虽然有效,但有两个主要局限性:(1) 由于试验时间的缩放或培训程序,它们引入了高昂的计算成本;(2) 它们对于范围更广的基础模型的适用性薄弱,因为它们假设能够推理或适应任务的LLMs. 因此,我们问,在解码过程中是否可以修复扭曲的分布,这将保留效率、无培训性质和广泛的适用性,使多样化的解码具有吸引力:我们能否通过改进解码本身来方便解释范围?

blocks.en:
Our answer starts from a simple observation: schema ambiguity typically arises among schema elements that describe closely related concepts, such as the author and the publisher, which both contribute to the release of a book. Such conceptual relatedness can be quantified by semantic similarity between schema element embeddings. As shown in Fig. 2 , schema elements that induce ambiguity show higher semantic similarities than random schema pairs on average. Therefore, semantic similarity provides an effective prior for identifying alternative schema interpretations.
We exploit it directly at decoding time: whenever the model is about to write a schema element, we raise the scores of the elements that are semantically closest to the one it currently favors, so that plausible alternatives rise out of the tail of the distribution and survive in the output set.
blocks.zh:
我们的答案是从一个简单的观察开始的:通常在描述密切相关概念的图谋要素之间,如作者和出版商之间产生计划模糊,两者都有助于发行一本书。 这种概念关联性可以通过语义上在schema元素嵌入上的相似性来量化. 如图2所示,诱发歧义的语义学元素平均显示的语义学相似度高于随机语义学对. 因此,语义相似性为确定备选的语法解释提供了有效的前序.
我们直接在解码时利用它:每当模型即将写出一个图案元素时,我们就会提高最接近它目前偏爱的元素的分数,这样,假想的替代品就会从分布的尾部冒出来,并在输出集中存活下来.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Similarity distribution. We randomly sample 80 examples from AmbiQT and Ambrosia, and compute the cosine similarity of embeddings between random schema element pairs and schema element pairs that induce ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 图 2:相似分布. 我们随机抽取了来自安比QT和安布罗西亚的80个例子,并计算出随机的schema元素对和schema元素对之间嵌入的余弦相似性,从而诱发模糊.

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on two benchmarks that contain schema ambiguity, across base models of different families and sizes. Our method significantly improves the interpretation coverage over conventional decoding methods and achieves performance comparable to methods that rely on fine-tuning or test-time scaling, while adding only about 10% latency over vanilla beam search.
blocks.zh: 我们根据两个基准来评估我们的方法,这两个基准在不同的家庭和大小的基本模型中都含有计划模糊性。 我们的方法比常规的解码方法大大提高了解码范围,并实现了与依赖于微调或测试时间缩放的方法相类似的性能,同时仅比香草束搜索增加了约10%的延迟度.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing work handles ambiguous questions by generating a set of SQL queries, which are either presented to users directly ( Vaidya et al. 2025 ; Saparina and Lapata 2025a ) or used for downstream disambiguation ( Chan, Sevastjanova, and El-Assady 2026 ; Qiu et al. 2025 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ) . Both settings rely on interpretation coverage.
blocks.zh: 现有作品通过生成一系列SQL查询来处理模棱两可的问题,这些查询要么直接提交用户(Vaidya等人,2025年;Saparina和Lapata 2025a),要么用于下游混沌(Chan,Sevastjanova,和El-Assady,2026年;Quu等人). 2025; 张等. 2025). 这两种设置都依赖口译。

blocks.en: For general ambiguity, DFPL ( Saparina and Lapata 2025a ) prompts LLMs to produce multiple natural language interpretations, augments them with a fine-tuned model and maps each to a SQL query, IntentRL ( Saparina and Lapata 2025b ) formulates interpretation generation as a reinforcement learning problem to explicitly encourage diversity, and CLEAR ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) exploits the reasoning ability of models with few-shot examples to map entities in the question to schema elements; none of them focuses on schema ambiguity specifically. Targeting schema ambiguity specifically, LogicalBeam ( Bhaskar et al. 2023 ) trains two models to first generate SQL templates and then fill them with schema elements, and ODIN ( Vaidya et al. 2025 ) masks the schema elements used in previous predictions to enforce the exploration of alternatives.
blocks.zh: 对于一般的模糊性,DFPL(Saparina and Lapata 2025a)促使LLMs制作多种自然语言解释,用微调模型加以扩充,并逐一绘制到SQL查询的地图,IntentRL(Saparina and Lapata 2025b)将解释生成作为一个强化的学习问题来明确鼓励多样性,CLEAR(Zhang等人,2025年)则利用模型的推理能力,用少镜头的例子将问题中的实体映射到计划元素;其中没有一个具体侧重于计划模糊. 具体针对计划模糊性,LogicalBeam(Baskar等人,2023年)培训了两种模型,首先生成SQL模板,然后填充计划元素,ODIN(Vaidya等人,2025年)掩盖了以往预测中用于强制探索替代品的计划元素.

blocks.en: All of these methods intervene on the input or on the model weights and leave the decoding algorithm itself unchanged, paying for diversity with extra prompts, extra generation passes or extra training. In contrast, we directly adjust the token distribution during decoding, which yields diverse SQL queries within a single parallel decoding pass.
blocks.zh: 所有这些方法都干预输入或模型权重,使解码算法本身保持不变,以额外的提示,额外的生成传承或额外的训练来支付多样性. 相比之下,我们在解码时直接调整符号分布,在单个平行解码通道内产生不同的SQL查询.

blocks.en: 3 Problem definition
blocks.zh: 3 问题定义

blocks.en: We first provide a definition of schema ambiguity in the context of text-to-SQL. Following previous work ( Floratou et al. 2024 ) , a question is ambiguous if multiple non-equivalent and acceptable SQL queries can answer it. When the natural language itself is clear, schema ambiguity occurs when there is more than one way to map the question to database schema.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在文本到SQL的语境中给出了图谋模糊的定义. 在之前的作品(Floratou et al. 2024)之后,如果多个非等效且可接受的SQL查询可以回答,那么一个问题就模糊不清. 当自然语言本身是明确的时,当有不止一种方法将问题映射到数据库的schema时,就会产生计划模糊.

blocks.en: Given a database schema D D , consisting of N N schema elements C = [ c 1 , c 2 , … , c N ] C=[c_{1},c_{2},...,c_{N}] , and a user question Q Q with schema ambiguity, there exist multiple non-equivalent but valid queries { y i } \{y_{i}\} that answer it. blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Method overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 方法概览

blocks.en: Consider a database with tables book, author and publisher, and the question "Show German books" (Fig. 1 ). Two interpretations are valid: books written by German authors, and books released by German publishers. The model has to choose between them at one decoding step, the step that generates the table name after JOIN. At that step, the logit distribution is highly skewed: one token dominates the probability distribution, while the other one is ranked much below. The second interpretation is lost because this skewed distribution hides it, so beam search or sampling will never reach this interpretation.
blocks.zh: 考虑建立一个有表书,作者和出版商的数据库,以及"展示德国图书"的问题(图1). 两种解释是有效的:德国作者撰写的书籍和德国出版商发行的书籍. 模型必须在一个解码步骤中选择它们,这个步骤生成JOIN之后的表名. 在该步骤中,对数分布高度扭曲:一个符号支配概率分布,而另一个则排在下面。 第二种解释之所以丢失,是因为这种扭曲的分布掩盖了它,所以光束搜索或采样永远不会达到这种解释.

blocks.en: Our key observation is that alternative interpretations of an ambiguous query come from schema elements that describe closely related concepts. Author and publisher both relate to the production of a book; name and ISBN both identify a book. We quantify this by embedding each schema element with an embedding model and calculating their pairwise cosine similarities. Schema elements that cause ambiguity have high similarity, while unrelated pairs usually have low similarity (Fig. 2 ). Although semantic similarity alone does not imply ambiguity, ambiguous schema elements almost always exhibit substantial semantic overlap.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要看法是,对含糊不清的询问的另一种解释来自描述密切相关概念的图谋要素。 作者和出版商都与一本书的制作有关;名称和ISBN都确定了一本书。 我们用嵌入模型嵌入每个计划元素, 计算出它们的对等余弦相似性, 以此量化。 导致歧义的Schema元素具有很高的相似性,而无关的对子通常具有较低的相似性(图2 ). 虽然单是语义相似并不意味着模糊,但模棱两可的语义要素几乎总是表现出实质性的语义重叠.

blocks.en: This leads to our method. Whenever the model is generating a schema element, we add to the logit of each candidate token a boost that depends on the schema similarities. For example, after generating book , the top-1 prediction for the next token is .name . We boost .IS because it leads to book.ISBN , which is semantically similar to book.name , while unrelated tokens receive little or no boost. In the following sections, we first describe how we decide whether to modify the logits at the current step (Section 4.2 ), and then present our algorithm for computing the boost (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 这导致了我们的方法。 每当模型生成一个图案元素时,我们在每个候选符号的登录中加入一个取决于图案相似性的助推. 例如,在生成书后,下一个符号的顶部-1预测是.name 。 我们推动。 因为它导致书。 ISBN),与书名(book. 在以下各节中,我们首先描述我们如何决定是否在当前步骤中修改对数(第4.2节),然后介绍我们计算助推的算法(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: 4.2 SQL generation tracking
blocks.zh: 4.2 SQL 生成跟踪

blocks.en: We first need to decide two things: when to modify the logits, and for which tokens. A SQL query consists of keywords, database values and schema elements. We intervene only while a schema element is being generated and only on tokens that are valid continuations of the schema element generated so far. Two problems make this non-trivial. First, the model generates tokens one by one, and nothing in the token itself tells us whether it belongs to a schema element. Second, a schema element often consists of several tokens, for example ISBN may be split into IS and BN , so that for a prefix token we do not know which schema element the model is generating. What we need is therefore a mechanism that, at every step, tells us whether the model is inside a schema element and, if so, which tokens may follow.
blocks.zh: 我们首先需要决定两件事:何时修改日志,以及哪些符号。 一个SQL查询由关键词,数据库值和计划元素组成. 我们只是当一个计划元素正在生成时才进行干预,并且只是在那些是迄今为止产生的计划元素的有效延续的符号上进行干预。 有两个问题使得这个非部落。 首先,模型逐个生成符号,符号本身没有任何内容告诉我们它是否属于一个图案元素. 其次,一个schema元素常常由几个符号组成,例如ISBN可能分裂为IS和BN,因此对于一个前缀符号,我们不知道模型生成的是哪个schema元素. 因此,我们需要的是一种机制,在每一个步骤上都告诉我们这个模型是否在一种计划要素内,如果是的话,可能遵循什么标志。

blocks.en: To achieve that we create a prefix tree ( Sharma et al. 2025 ) with all the schema elements. More specifically, in an offline stage , we tokenize all schema elements, i.e., table.column for the columns, and insert them into a token-level prefix tree, in which every path from the root to a leaf corresponds to a schema element. Then, during decoding , maintain a pointer over the tree, which records the schema element generation point at each decoding step. The pointer has two possible states: (1) None, when the model is not generating any schema element or the model starts to generate a new clause (2) prefix tree node, while a schema element is being generated. In each step we update the pointer as follows: if the pointer is None, we check if the next top-1 token matches a child of the root node of a prefix tree and we set the pointer to root if this is the case. If the pointer is at root or at an inner node of the prefix tree, we advance the pointer to the child matching the last generated token. When the pointer has reached a leaf node, we set the pointer to None, if the next-token is not a child of the root, otherwise it is set to root.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们创建了具有所有计划元素的前缀树(Sharma等人,2025年)。 更具体地说,在离线阶段,我们表示所有计划元素,即表。 栏中,并插入一个符号级前缀树,其中从根到叶的每一条路径都对应一个图案元素。 然后,在解码过程中,在树上保持一个指针,这个指针记录每个解码步骤的schema元素生成点. 指针有两种可能的状态:(1)无,当模型没有产生任何schema元素时,或者当模型开始产生新的条款(2)前缀树节点时,同时生成schema元素. 在每个步骤中,我们将指针更新如下: 如果指针是无的,我们就检查下一个顶-1令牌是否与前缀树根节点的子匹配,如果情况是这样,我们就将指针设置为根. 如果指针位于前缀树的根部或内节点,我们就会将指针推进到孩子身上,与最后生成的符号匹配. 当指针已经到达一个叶节点时,我们把指针设置为无,如果下一个指针不是根的子,否则就被设定为根.

blocks.en: In the example, the pointer is None while the model generates SELECT , so the logits are unchanged. When the model generates book , the pointer advances to the internal node reached by root-book , indicating that the model is inside a schema element. Only the node’s children, such as .name and .IS , are valid continuations; .title is treated as hallucinated and suppressed by logit adjustment. Once the element is complete, the pointer reaches a leaf, returns to None , and decoding continues normally.
blocks.zh: 在示例中,指针是None,而模型生成SELECT,因此对数不变. 当模型生成书时,指针推进到根书所达到的内部节点,表明模型在一个计划元素内. 只有节点的孩子,如.name和.IS,才是有效的续作;.title作为幻觉处理,并通过登录调整压制. 元素完成后,指针到达一叶,返回无,解码正常继续.

blocks.en: Logits are adjusted only when the pointer is at the root node or at an inner node state and the tokens to be adjusted become only the children of the pointed node.
blocks.zh: 只有当指针处于根节点或内节点状态时,才调整逻辑,所调整的符号才成为指针节点的子.

blocks.en: Finally, we enable the mechanism only where schema alternatives are meaningful: table names in SELECT , FROM , and JOIN , and column names in SELECT , WHERE , GROUP BY , HAVING , and ORDER BY . We exclude columns inside COUNT to avoid unnecessary randomness, and the ON clause because its columns are fixed by primary–foreign key relationships; alternatives would invalidate the join condition. Fig. 3 illustrates these positions.

blocks.en: 4.3 Semantic-aware logit adjustment (SLA)
blocks.zh: 4.3 语义意识记录调整

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 SLA at one decoding step
blocks.zh: 算法 1 SLA 在一个解码步骤

blocks.en: We proceed in four steps, pointing to the lines of Algorithm 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们分四步前进,指向算法1线.

blocks.en: Each schema element is represented by a short text, the table name for a table and table.column for a column. We encode it with an off-the-shelf sentence embedding model, and store all pairwise cosine similarities in S ∈ ℝ N × N S\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times N} . This happens once per database, before decoding (line 1). Raw cosine values are not comparable across embedding models: one may place most schema pairs in [ 0.6 , 0.9 ] [0.6,0.9] , another in [ 0.0 , 0.4 ] [0.0,0.4] . Since our boost is proportional to them, a fixed hyper-parameter would act differently for each model. Only the relative order of the pairs matters to us, so we apply histogram equalization and replace each similarity by the fraction of pairs scoring below it. This spreads the values of any model uniformly over [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , so one setting of the strength parameter transfers across models.
blocks.zh: 每个方案元素都用一个简短的文本来表示,表格和表格的表格名称。 栏。 我们用现成的句子嵌入模式编码它,并将所有对偶的余弦相似之处存储在 S Q → R N → N S\in\ mathbb{ R\\ N\ times N}中. 在解码之前,每个数据库都发生过这种情况(第1行)。 原始余弦值在嵌入模型中并不具有可比性:一种可能将大多数的计数对放在[0.6,0.9] [0.6,0.9]中,另一种则放在[0.0,0.4][0.0,0.4]中. 由于我们的助推量与它们成正比, 固定的超参数对每个模型都不同。 只有对子的相对顺序对我们很重要,所以我们应用直方图平方,并以下方对子评分的分数来取代每一个相似性. 这将任何模型的值统一分布在 [0, 1] [0, 1] 上,所以一个设置的强度参数会跨模型转移.

blocks.en: 4.4 SchemaBeam
blocks.zh: 4.4 石马束

blocks.en: Because our algorithm operates by modifying logits, it is compatible with both deterministic and stochastic decoding methods, such as beam search and random sampling. In practice, beam search provides better interpretation coverage, so we introduce SchemaBeam, which integrates SLA into standard beam search. Vanilla beam search, however, often produces unhelpful token-level diversity, including formatting variants (e.g., trailing semicolons or code fences) and logically equivalent queries that differ only in join order or other syntactic details. SchemaBeam reduces this redundancy by masking related tokens during decoding and deduplicating outputs syntactically using their ASTs.
blocks.zh: 因为我们的算法是通过修改日志运行的,它既兼容定理法,也兼容断面解码法,如光束搜索和随机采样. 在实践中,光束搜索可以提供更好的解释覆盖,因此我们引入了将SchemaBeam纳入标准光束搜索的SchemaBeam. 然而,香草束搜索往往会产生无益的符号级多样性,包括格式化的变体(如跟踪分号或代码栅栏)和逻辑上等同的查询,这些查询只在组合顺序或其他合成细节上有所不同. SchemaBeam在解码和解码输出时,在战术上使用它们的AST来掩盖相关的令牌,从而减少这种冗余.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en: We select two benchmarks that contain one or more ambiguity categories related to schema ambiguity: ∙ \bullet AmbiQT ( Bhaskar et al. 2023 ) This dataset is modified from Spider ( Yu et al. 2018 ) and contains fine-grained schema ambiguity types. For each question, the authors modify the database schema and create two alternative interpretations. We evaluate on Column, Join and Table ambiguity, with 2948 examples in total. ∙ \bullet Ambrosia ( Saparina and Lapata 2024 ) . Ambrosia is an LLM-generated benchmark with three ambiguity types: scope, attachment, and vagueness. Scope and attachment arise from the natural-language question, whereas vagueness corresponds to schema ambiguity and is most comparable to AmbiQT. We evaluate on the 373 vagueness examples. Some examples include a third interpretation formed by combining the two alternatives, e.g., SELECT a, b in addition to SELECT a and SELECT b . We remove this combined interpretation because it is not independent of the first two and to keep the evaluation consistent with AmbiQT.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了两个基准,其中包含一个或多个与图谋模糊有关的模糊类别:\bullet AmbiQT(Baskar等人)。 2023) (中文(简体) ). 本数据集由Spider(Yu等人,2018年)修改而来,包含细纹的schema模糊类型. 每个问题,作者都会修改数据库计划,并产生两种替代解释. 我们评价栏、栏和表的模糊性,共有2 948个例子。 * 阿布莱特·安布罗西亚(Saparina和Lapata 2024) Ambrosia是一个LLM生成的基准,有三种模糊类型:范围,附件,和模糊. 范围和依附源于自然语言问题,而模糊则相当于图谋模糊,与AmbiQT最可比较. 我们评价373个含糊不清的例子。 一些例子包括结合两种替代品形成的第三种解释,例如,除SELECT a和SELECT b之外,还有SELECT a。 我们取消了这种综合解释,因为它不独立于前两种解释,并使评价与AmbiQT保持一致。

blocks.en: For both benchmarks, we measure how well the prediction set covers the possible interpretations. Following AmbiQT, we use EitherInTopK and BothInTopK, which report the percentage of examples for which at least one or both interpretations appear among the top-K predictions. When a method produces more than K predictions, we evaluate only the first K. Following ( Bhaskar et al. 2023 ) , we set K=5 by default. We also report inference latency, which is measured by comparing each method to vanilla beam search with the same base model.
blocks.zh: 就这两个基准而言,我们衡量一套预测如何涵盖可能的解释。 在安比QT之后,我们使用OneInTopK和BothInTopK,它们报告在K顶级预测中至少有一个或两个解释的例子的百分比。 当一种方法产生超过K的预测时,我们只评价第一个K. follows(Baskar等人,2023年),我们默认将K=5设定. 我们还报告推论延缓性,通过将每种方法与香草束搜索与同一个基模型进行比较来测量.

blocks.en: We list a series of model-agnostic baselines and comparison methods. Apart from methods that aim to generate multiple interpretations under ambiguity, we also look into state-of-the-art text-to-SQL systems that generate diverse SQL queries. All experiments are conducted on two NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs in a Linux environment. We categorize all methods into three classes based on the key techniques they adopt: • Decoding methods : Following previous work ( Bhaskar et al. 2023 ) , we adopt beam search and random sampling as two baselines. A beam width of 10 and a temperature of 1.0 are used. We also evaluate model ensemble which is widely adopted in many systems ( Liu et al. 2026 ; Wang et al. 2025 ) . We combine predictions from models with beam search in a round-robin manner after deduplication. • Fine-tuning-based methods : These methods rely on task-specific fine-tuned models, including LogicalBeam ( Bhaskar et al. 2023 ) and DFPL ( Saparina and Lapata 2025a ) . • Prompt-based methods : Some methods manipulate the model input to generate different interpretations, usually dependent on carefully designed prompts and exploiting the reasoning ability of LLMs, including ODIN ( Vaidya et al. 2025 ) , CLEAR ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) . Moreover, we adopt the prompt strategy used in Ambrosia that acknowledges the existence of ambiguity, denoted as Prompt. Some systems also incorporate generators with different reasoning strategies ( Pourreza et al. 2024 ) . We evaluate Deepeye-SQL ( Li et al. 2026 ) which adopts skeleton-based, ICL, and divide-and-conquer as three strategies. For each strategy, we sample K times and select candidates in the same way in model ensemble.
blocks.zh: 我们列出了一系列模型不可知基线和比较方法。 除了旨在在模糊性下产生多种解释的方法外,我们还研究产生多种SQL查询的最先进的文本到SQL系统. 所有实验都是在Linux环境下用两个NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU进行的. 我们根据采用的关键技术,将所有方法分为三个类别: 解码方法:遵循先前的工作(Baskar等人,2023年),我们采用光束搜索和随机取样作为两个基线。 采用梁宽10度,温度1.0. 我们还评价许多系统广泛采用的模式组合(刘等人,2026年;王等人,2025年)。 我们把模型的预测和光束的搜索结合起来,在分解后以圆旋矩方式进行. • 支助 基于微调的方法: 这些方法依赖于特定任务微调模型,包括逻辑束(Baskar等人,2023年)和DFPL(Saparina和Lapata 2025a年). • 快速方法: 一些方法操纵模型输入生成不同的解释,通常依赖于精心设计的提示,并利用LLMs的推理能力,包括ODIN(Vaidya等人,2025年),CLEAR(张等人,2025年). 此外,我们采取了在安布罗西亚采用的迅速战略,它承认存在模糊性,即 " 迅速 " 。 一些系统还纳入了具有不同推理策略的发电机(Pourreza等人,2024年)。 我们评价Deepeye-SQL(Li等人,2026年),它采用骨架式的ICL和分割和征服作为三种策略. 每种策略,我们都会对K时间进行抽样,并在模型综艺节目中以同样的方式选择候选人.

blocks.en: We consider two variants of our method. The first is Constrained beam search , which applies SLA to vanilla beam search with α = 0 \alpha=0 , thereby reducing decoding to schema-element constraints without similarity-based logit adjustment. The second is SchemaBeam (Section 4.4 ), which uses all-MiniLM-L6-v2 from Hugging Face to compute similarities between schema elements.

blocks.en: 5.2 Performance with different models
blocks.zh: 5.2 不同模型的性能

blocks.en: We evaluate decoding methods on three base models: Llama3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-Coder-14B, and Qwen3.6-27B. We use α = 0.7 \alpha=0.7 for Qwen2.5-Coder-14B and α = 0.8 \alpha=0.8 for the others. Table 1 reports the results; where SchemaBeam improves BothInTopK in every setting; sampling is averaged over three runs.
blocks.zh: 我们评价三种基本模型的解码方法: Llama3.1-8B, Quen2.5-Coder-14B, 以及 Qune3.6-27B. 我们使用α=0.7\alpha=0.7 Quen2.5-Coder-14B 和α = 0.8\ alpha = 0.8 其他数据。 表1汇报了结果;SchemaBeam在每一个场合都改进了Both InTopK;抽样平均分三次进行。

blocks.en: By constraining models to adhere to database schema elements, both metrics are improved in most cases, especially for BothInTopK. This is because we prevent hallucinated tokens, and simultaneously reduce the search space. SchemaBeam further enhances the performance even for EitherInTopK, which is partly due to cases where the top-1 prediction is wrong but semantically similar to one of the ground truth schema elements. The increased probability of the correct schema elements contributes to the improvement. Other factors such as deduplication, unhelpful token-masking are analyzed in the ablation study.
blocks.zh: 通过限制模型以坚持数据库的计数元素,在大多数情况下这两个度量衡都得到了改进,特别是对于BothInTopK. 这是因为我们防止了幻觉信号,同时缩小了搜索空间. SchemaBeam进一步提升了即使是OneInTopK的性能,这部分是由于前1预测错误但与地面真知灼见元素之一类似的情况. 正确计划要素的概率增加有助于改进。 减肥,无益的装模作样等其他因素在减肥研究中分析.

blocks.en: However, for stronger base models which are more likely to generate the correct schema element and less likely to hallucinate, the additional diversity in schema element generation does not necessarily boost EitherInTopK. Another reason is that for the remaining incorrect predictions, the errors usually arise from incorrect SQL structures, such as redundant or missing subqueries and clauses, rather than incorrect schema elements. This also explains why the 14B and 27B models with SchemaBeam show similar results. But the interpretation coverage is consistently improved, demonstrating the applicability of our method to different base models, and the advantage over conventional decoding methods.
blocks.zh: 然而,对于较强的基础模型而言,这些模型更有可能产生正确的计划元件,而不太可能产生幻觉,因此计划元件生成中的额外多样性并不一定会促进OheinInTopK. 另一个原因是,对于剩余的不正确的预测,错误通常来自不正确的SQL结构,如冗余或缺失的子槽和条款,而不是不正确的计划元素. 这也解释了为什么与SchemaBeam合作的14B和27B模型显示出类似的结果. 但解释范围不断改进,表明我们的方法适用于不同的基本模型,而且优于传统的解码方法。

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparison with other methods
blocks.zh: 5.3 与其他方法的比较

blocks.en: We further compare SchemaBeam with existing methods for improving interpretation coverage. Prior work lacks a fair, comprehensive comparison because methods often use different base models, metrics, and dataset splits. To control for these factors, we reimplement all open-source methods with Qwen2.5-Coder-14B, which balances effectiveness and efficiency, and evaluate them under the same pipeline. Methods requiring task-specific fine-tuning are evaluated with their released fine-tuned models. For ODIN, whose code is unavailable, we report results with Claude 3 Haiku. Table 2 presents the results; our main findings are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们还将SchemaBeam与改进口译覆盖面的现有方法进行比较。 之前的工作缺乏公平,全面的比较,因为方法往往使用不同的基础模型,度量衡,和数据集的分割. 为了控制这些因素,我们用Quen2.5-Coder-14B重新实施所有开源方法,这种方法平衡了效力和效率,并在同一个管道下加以评价. 需要针对具体任务进行微调的方法用其发布的微调模型进行评估。 对于代码不详的ODIN,我们报告结果 与克劳德3海库。 表2列出结果;我们的主要调查结果如下:

blocks.en: Prompt-based methods usually incur high latency, which is mainly caused by the increased context length, especially instructions and few-shot examples, and extra reasoning content they generate during the decoding process. However, they do not necessarily achieve superior performance. One important observation is that ensembling generators with different reasoning strategies fails to handle potential schema ambiguity. Moreover, these methods are highly dependent on the model capability, as we find a large performance drop of CLEAR when switching from GPT-4o which is used in the original paper to other weaker base models.
blocks.zh: 即时制方法通常会有很高的耐久性,这主要是由于上下文长度增加,特别是指令和少镜头的例子,以及它们在解码过程中产生的额外推理内容. 然而,它们并不一定取得优异的业绩。 一项重要的意见是,具有不同推理策略的聚合发电机未能处理潜在的计划模糊问题。 此外,这些方法高度依赖模型能力,因为我们发现,在从最初纸张使用的GPT-4o转换到其他较弱的基础模型时,CLEAR的性能下降很大。

blocks.en: Fine-tuning-based methods fall short in the generalization ability. Logicalbeam which is fine-tuned on SPIDER, fails to generalize to the Ambrosia dataset due to database domain shift and the limitations of the base model. Although DFPL performs well in several datasets, it is incapable of capturing JOIN ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 基于微调的方法在概括能力上还不足. 由于数据库域移位和基础模型的局限性,对天基信息平台进行微调的逻辑束未能概括到安布罗西亚数据集。 虽然DFPL在多个数据集中表现良好,但它无法捕捉JOIN的模糊性.

blocks.en: Decoding methods are generally more efficient, and show stable performance across diverse datasets. We notice that combining predictions from Llama and QwenCoder yields better results. The improved diversity could be attributed to different training corpora, optimizing objectives, etc.
blocks.zh: 解码方法一般效率更高,并显示不同数据集的性能稳定. 我们注意到,结合Llama和QuenCoder的预测,结果会更好。 多样性的改善可归因于不同的培训团队、优化目标等。

blocks.en: Table 2: Performance comparison across different methods.
blocks.zh: 图表 2: 不同方法的绩效比较。

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 5.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: We conduct an ablation study on Column (C) and Table (T) ambiguity with Llama to examine the impact of SchemaBeam’s hyperparameters and components. Similar trends are observed across other datasets and base models.
blocks.zh: 我们对与Llama的列(C)和表(T)的模糊性进行了研究,以审查SchemaBeam超参数和组件的影响。 其他数据集和基准模型也有类似趋势。

blocks.en: We vary the number of final outputs among 3,5,7 for SchemaBeam and vanilla beam search to analyze where correct predictions are ranked. As shown in Fig. 4 (left), the interpretation coverage grows as K increases. But for SchemaBeam, the curve exhibits a steeper slope at the beginning, which indicates the correct interpretations are more likely to be ranked at higher positions. We also report the results with α ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \alpha\in[0,1] in Fig. 4 (right), where we observe a steady growth initially, peaking around α = 0.8 \alpha=0.8 , and then starts to drop. The main reason is that a large α \alpha distorts the original distribution, which reflects how well each schema element fits the current context.
blocks.zh: 我们在3,5,7个最终产出中,对SchemaBeam和vanilla Beam进行搜索,以分析正确的预测。 如图4(左)所示,口译覆盖面随着K的增加而增加。 但对于SchemaBeam来说,曲线在开头显示一个更陡峭的坡度,这说明正确的解释更可能排列在更高的位置. 我们还在图4(右)中用α ∈ [0, 1]\ alpha\in [0, 1] 报告结果,我们最初观察到稳步增长,在α = 0.8\ alpha= 0.8左右达到峰值,然后开始下降。 主要原因是一个大α-α扭曲了原始分布,这反映了每个计划元素如何适合当前上下文.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Interpretation coverage vs K and α \alpha .
blocks.zh: 图4:口译覆盖率与K和α-α。

blocks.en: Table 3: Component Analysis.
blocks.zh: 表3:构成部分分析。

blocks.en: Next we analyze each component in SchemaBeam, including the choice of embedding models (all-mpnet-base-v2, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B), similarity aggregation strategies. We also gradually remove (1) syntactic deduplication, (2) unhelpful token masking and (3) SLA, with the final variant reducing to vanilla beam search. Results in Table 3 show that our method is not sensitive to the choice of embedding models, as our method relies on the coarse-grained similarity structure rather than exact similarity values, while different embedding models typically introduce only small shifts in similarity scores after normalization. We witness a performance drop in table ambiguity when replacing our similarity aggregation strategy with average pooling, since it weakens the similarity estimation between tables. Finally, all additional designs in SchemaBeam contribute to performance improvements, with SLA providing the largest gain.
blocks.zh: 接着我们分析SchemaBeam中的每个组件,包括嵌入模型的选择(all-mpnet-base-v2,Qune3-Embedding-0.6B),相似性聚合策略. 我们还逐渐去除(1)综合疏解,(2)无益的代号蒙面和(3)SLA,最后的变体减小为香草束搜索. 表3的结果显示,我们的方法对嵌入模型的选择不敏感,因为我们的方法依赖于粗糙的相似性结构,而不是精确的相似性值,而不同的嵌入模型通常只在正常化后引入相似性分数的小变动. 我们看到,在用平均汇集来取代我们的相似性汇总战略时,表上的模棱两可性有所下降,因为它削弱了各表之间的相似性估计。 最后,SchemaBeam的所有额外设计都有助于改进业绩,而苏丹解放军是最大的收益。

blocks.en: 5.5 Case study
blocks.zh: 5.5 导弹 个案研究

blocks.en: Fig. 5 shows two representative examples: Case 1, where vanilla beam search fails and SchemaBeam succeeds, and Case 2, where SchemaBeam fails while beam search succeeds. In Case 1, the base model hallucinates columns and selects an incorrect column, whereas SchemaBeam covers both valid interpretations. In Case 2, the correct query requires COUNT(*) , but SchemaBeam ranks it lower because increasing schema-level diversity also introduces randomness in other schema choices. As a result, SchemaBeam detects the ambiguous columns but fails to rank the correct interpretations sufficiently high.
blocks.zh: 图5显示了两个具有代表性的例子:第1号案件,香草光束搜索失败,SchemaBeam成功;第2号案件,SchemaBeam在光束搜索成功时失败。 在案例1中,基模型会产生导列并选择一个不正确的导列,而SchemaBeam则涵盖了两种有效的解释. 在案例2中,正确的查询需要COUNT(*),但SchemaBeam将其排序更低,因为不断提高的schema级别多样性也引入了其他schema选择中的随机性. 因此,SchemaBeam检测到模棱两可的列,但未能对正确的解释进行足够高的排序.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Two examples with vanilla beam search and SchemaBeam. We highlight hallucinated (red) and correct (green) schema elements.
blocks.zh: 图5:香草束搜索和SchemaBeam的两个例子。 我们强调幻觉(红色)和正确的(绿色)计划元素。

blocks.en: 5.6 Key takeaways
blocks.zh: 5.6 主要外卖

blocks.en: SchemaBeam consistently improves interpretation coverage. Across three base models and both benchmarks, it improves BothInTopK over vanilla beam search in every setting, often by large margins, and improves EitherInTopK in most cases. The gains are largest for weaker models but remain visible for stronger ones, showing that skewed decoding distributions, rather than model capability alone, limit coverage.
blocks.zh: SchemaBeam不断提高口译覆盖率。 在整个三个基本模型和两个基准中,它改进了BothInTopK在每一种情况下的香草光束搜索,常常是很大的边际,并在大多数情况下改进了BothInTopK。 对较弱的模型来说,收益最大,但对于较强的模型来说,收益仍然可见,这表明,扭曲的解码分布,而不仅仅是模型能力,限制了覆盖面。

blocks.en: SchemaBeam also provides a strong accuracy–efficiency trade-off. Prompt-based methods are 1.59–10.9 × \times slower than beam search and still underperform, while reasoning ensembles do not directly address schema ambiguity. Fine-tuning methods are competitive but brittle: LogicalBeam does not transfer to Ambrosia, and DFPL collapses on JOIN ambiguity. SchemaBeam matches or outperforms these methods at only 1.1 × \times beam-search latency, requires no training, and remains robust across datasets.
blocks.zh: 司马 Beam还提供了很强的准确性-效率权衡。 即时方法为1.59–10.9 ×\时间比光束搜索慢,并且仍然表现不佳,而推理综艺并不直接解决计划模糊问题. 微调方法具有竞争性,但简洁:逻辑束不转投安布罗西亚,DFPL在JOIN模糊度上崩溃. SchemaBeam只在1.1×x\时束-搜索空档时匹配或超过这些方法,不需要训练,并且在各数据集之间保持稳健.

blocks.en: Overall , SchemaBeam shows that lightweight decoding-time intervention can substantially improve ambiguity coverage in text-to-SQL without training, prompting overhead, or dataset-specific failure modes.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,SchemaBeam显示轻量级解码-时间干预可以大幅提高文本到SQL的模糊度,无需经过培训,引发间接费用,或数据集特定故障模式.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This paper proposes an efficient, training-free decoding method that encourages the exploration of alternative schema interpretations. By leveraging semantic similarities between schema elements through logit adjustment, our method substantially improves interpretation coverage over conventional decoding methods. It achieves performance comparable to fine-tuning and reasoning-based approaches while incurring much lower latency, demonstrating that decoding-time intervention is an effective and practical solution for diverse SQL query generation.
blocks.zh: 本文提出一种高效,无培训的解码方法,鼓励探索其他方案解释. 通过通过对帐调整利用各方案要素之间的语义相似性,我们的方法比常规的解码方法大大提高了解释范围。 它实现的性能与微调和推理方法相当,同时产生低得多的延迟,表明解码时间干预是多种SQL查询生成的有效而实用的解决方案.
